actual_model: Not independently observable; parent assigned requested reviewer seat.
scope: Final implementation review: commercial feasibility, license/data evidence, local deployment assumptions and claim boundaries.

findings.title: Supported Linux layout is narrower than generic Java 17 prerequisites
evidence: BubblewrapLauncher.command uses absolute /usr/bin/prlimit and /usr/bin/bwrap, requires /lib64 and /etc/java-17-openjdk, and mounts java.home read-only.
run_local.py checks tools with shutil.which, while the production launcher uses fixed absolute paths.
README lists Linux, Java/Javac 17, bwrap and prlimit without specifying these filesystem requirements.
findings.impact: A different Linux distribution or Java layout can pass preliminary prerequisites and fail all worker launches. Failure is closed, not a sandbox bypass.
findings.recommendation: Document the currently required runtime paths and host namespace support; do not imply arbitrary Linux/JDK installations or hosted multiuser deployments are supported.

findings.title: Dataset admission-size counts belong to the older contract
evidence: docs/dataset-inventory.json records source_byte_limit_in_existing_contract = 262144 for all three roots.
Inventory expressly says size counts only and no parser/import admission attempted.
findings.impact: The counts cannot be used to estimate how many models G1 accepts. The field is labeled as historical, so this is a qualification rather than a demonstrated incorrect admission.
findings.recommendation: Keep the historical label explicit in final reporting; a later selected evaluation must apply current size, parser and import gates anew.

findings.title: Artifact hashes and notice inventory do not close redistribution or corpus rights
evidence: dependencies.json purpose explicitly disclaims redistribution clearance and commercial_release_cleared is false.
dependency_inventory.py collects embedded pom.properties and notice hashes; it does not produce a full nested-component license/obligation resolution or frontend transitive notice report.
dataset-inventory.json distinguishes operational local authorization from third-party reuse rights and records unresolved rights for all roots.
implementation-g1.json explicitly forbids publication, commercial release, remote embeddings and dataset training in current authorization.
findings.impact: Current evidence supports bounded local development accounting only. Commercial packaging, dataset derivatives and remote services require separately authorized purpose-specific rights evidence and complete shipping-component analysis.
findings.recommendation: Retain these release gates; do not describe the inventory as legal clearance or a complete distribution compliance report.

confirmed_boundaries: LoopbackBinding enforces 127.0.0.1 independently of ordinary Spring address settings. AuthorityFilter checks exact Host and supplied Origin and requires bearer authority for /api/.
Production worker launcher clears its environment, uses namespace isolation with die-with-parent, read-only runtime mounts and private tmpfs; no unsandboxed fallback was found in reviewed code.
The trusted host, JDK, system libraries, build outputs and launcher account remain part of the operational trust boundary; namespace flags and a canary test are not universal OS isolation assurance.
BuildIdentity records compiled/dependency bytes but only java.runtime.version for the JDK. It must not be represented as complete byte-level JDK/OS provenance.
README separates structural pseudonymization, deterministic features, model proofs and implementation assurance, and expressly says production platform and commercial clearance are incomplete.
Inventory exposes aggregate counts, hashes and notice attribution metadata, not exported model contents; those hashes and preserved structure are not guarantees of anonymity.

validation.performed: Read-only source/document inspection and report JSON serialization.
not_performed: No Maven/build invocation or production modifications.
No new corpus access, import, remote embedding, publication or external research.
No independent comprehensive repository content scan to substantiate the historical no-source-copy assertion.
No fresh sandbox execution or frontend browser acceptance test.
No legal determination or verification of upstream license conflict beyond recorded local evidence.

limits: This advisory review concerns the recorded hashes at inspection time, not later edits. No commercial demand, price, support cost or revenue evidence was collected; technical local feasibility does not establish commercial viability.
